verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web-data API (not itself an agent), so the MCP-server axis applies, and it publishes an official hosted MCP endpoint (mcp.context.dev/mcp) plus install docs for connecting AI clients to its tools for live web/company data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server working in practice beyond first-party docs and a probe confirming the endpoint exists.
